title_zh: 京张双层验证：公开共创过程与城市可信应用
title_en: Jing-Zhang Two-Level Test: Public Co-Creation Process and Trusted Urban Application

proposition.zh: 共创过程正在发生并已有部分公开记录；本方案提出的城市应用层仍须通过H0-H4外部实证。两层证据不得相互替代。
proposition.en: The co-creation process is underway with partial public records; the urban-application level proposed here still requires H0-H4 external evidence. The two evidence levels are not interchangeable.

public_work_loop.human_authority: Maintainers and professional/public authorities define scope and lawful boundaries.
Agent output is a professional contribution, not an autonomous public decision.

public_work_loop.label_zh: 来源、假设与结构化证据
public_work_loop.human_authority: Traceability supports review; it does not certify truth, approval or implementation.

public_work_loop.evidence_scope: PR 4306 records the V0.14/V0.14.1 defect-detection, participant-repair, deterministic-recheck, 96/100 advisory reassessment, intake-acceptance and merge cycle. PR 4308 records V0.15 deterministic validation PASS, a 100/100 advisory Review Agent result, formal-review-ready and featured-candidate recommendations, repository-intake acceptance and merge at head 868ebbabce94193785e2d4100532874f2d7bf11f. These are repository process facts only: neither advisory result is formal jury scoring, and intake/merge are not Gallery publication, award selection, planning approval, procurement, implementation or government endorsement.
public_work_loop.human_authority: Checks and public comments identify issues; they do not make statutory or competition decisions.

public_work_loop.label_zh: 人类与专业团队最终判断
public_work_loop.human_authority: Selection, professional deepening, planning approval, procurement and rights-affecting decisions remain with accountable people and institutions.

public_work_loop.label_zh: 公共知识、版本与未采纳理由
public_work_loop.label_en: Public knowledge, versions and non-adoption reasons
public_work_loop.human_authority: Rights clearance, confidentiality, privacy and accountable disclosure govern what may enter the public archive.

documented_revision_cycle.boundary: This cycle demonstrates traceable task interpretation, failure detection, participant repair, deterministic recheck, advisory reassessment and repository intake. It does not populate FP01 H0-H4 and does not prove formal selection, adoption, field feasibility or public benefit.

latest_reviewed_intake.boundary: The 100/100 result is an advisory Review Agent result for the cited V0.15 package hash, not a formal jury score or a guarantee for V0.16. Intake and merge do not prove Gallery publication, selection, adoption, implementation, government endorsement, national designation or public benefit.

external_evidence_boundary.rule: Repository participation, CI, Issues, PRs, intake labels, merge or advisory review never populate site, user, baseline, budget, professional sign-off, rehearsal, authorization or outcome evidence. PR 4306 records the V0.14/V0.14.1 repair/intake cycle and PR 4308 records V0.15 deterministic PASS, advisory 100/100, intake and merge. Neither result is formal jury scoring; intake and merge are not selection, adoption or implementation.
